name: Oath of the Ancients

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A paladin sworn to protect the light and life of the world, wielding nature's wrath and an aura that wards off harmful magic.

feature.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
feature.summary: Ensnaring Strike and Speak with Animals always prepared; more at levels 5, 9, 13 and 17.
feature.text: When you reach a Paladin level shown, you always have these spells prepared; they don't count against your Prepared Spells: Ensnaring Strike and Speak with Animals (3); Misty Step and Moonbeam (5); Plant Growth and Protection from Energy (9); Ice Storm and Stoneskin (13); Commune with Nature and Tree Stride (17).

feature.name: Nature's Wrath
feature.summary: Channel Divinity, Magic action: creatures of your choice within 15 feet make a Strength save or are Restrained by spectral vines for 1 minute.
feature.text: As a Magic action you can expend a use of Channel Divinity to conjure spectral vines around nearby creatures. Each creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet of you makes a Strength saving throw or has the Restrained condition for 1 minute. A Restrained creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

feature.name: Aura of Warding
feature.summary: You and allies in your Aura of Protection resist Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage.
feature.text: Ancient magic lies so heavily on you that it forms a ward: you and your allies within your Aura of Protection have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic and Radiant damage. Your own Resistance is applied; allies' needs positions in a fight.

feature.name: Undying Sentinel
feature.summary: Once per Long Rest drop to 1 Hit Point instead of 0 and regain three times your Paladin level; you don't age magically.

feature.name: Elder Champion
feature.summary: Bonus Action, once per Long Rest: for 1 minute regain 10 Hit Points each turn, cast Paladin spells as a Bonus Action, and nearby enemies have Disadvantage on saves against your spells.
